title: 寒假见闻
pages_note: Read off the 目录 (教材 PDF index 11, printed contents p. 1) and confirmed on each rendered page: 第一课 runs pp. 2–11, 第二课《故宫》 starts p. 12. 课堂练习 is pp. 5–8 (描一描写一写 5, 读一读/用一用 6, 扩展与替换/想一想 7, 对话/课堂游戏 8); the 阅读 text is pp. 9–10 with its 想一想 and 日积月累 on p. 11. The 课文's own 想一想，说一说 (three questions, p. 7), the 对话 between 云云 and 亮亮 and the 课堂游戏 (北京有……, p. 8) are not carried here, as in L03–L05.

课文.text_note: Fully pinyin-annotated in the book. Not reproduced, by the same decision as L05: docs/chinese.md § 8 holds every 课文 back until the owner says where it may live.

生字.gloss_note: character and 拼音 are the book's; the gloss is authored here in both languages and is not printed in the book. The list gives 切 as qiè, the reading in 亲切 (qīnqiè); the knife reading qiē is not on the page and is not taught here. The two blue boxes under the list on p. 4 read 刀——切 and 旡——既 (the second is 旡, the form with the short stroke on top, not 无).

gloss.zh: 听到；见闻就是看到的和听到的
gloss.en: hear; 见闻 is what one sees and hears
city; city wall, as in 长城

gloss.zh: 亲切的"切"：让人觉得很近、很温暖
gloss.en: as in 亲切, warm and familiar

gloss.zh: 力气；人力车就是靠人的力气走的车
gloss.en: strength; 人力车 is a cart moved by a person's strength
join together; as in 四合院, a courtyard house

gloss.zh: 像晴天天空那样的颜色

gloss.en: a sum of money; 付款 is to pay

gloss.zh: 拿别人的东西来用，用完要还；把东西给别人用，叫"借给"别人

专有名词.section_note: As in L03: the book prints 专有名词 (Proper nouns) between 词语 and 句子 on p. 4, with the pinyin capitalised as a name. 天安门 is printed Tiān’ān Mén, with the syllable-dividing apostrophe.

阅读.text_note: same copyright hold as the 课文. The text is a diary entry headed 1月20日 星期四 天气：晴. The margin prints ★ before each entry, and each carries example phrases under it rather than a gloss, kept here in brackets as L04 keeps 帮忙 and 表示; 共享's second example is printed 共享Wi-Fi（网络）, kept as printed inside the brackets. 观光 is on p. 9; 共享, 环保 and 小吃 on p. 10. p. 11 carries the reading's 想一想，说一说 (three questions) and 日积月累 (读万卷书，行万里路。——（明）董其昌), neither reproduced.
